title: Nurturing curiosity in democracy, one quiz at a time: Ready for the Law Challenge
description: The days of Derek O'Brien's Bournvita Quiz Contest and Siddhartha Basu's Mastermind may be locked away in some quiet corner of time, but could bringing back quizzing and nurturing curiosity in young and old minds alike be just what the times call for?When Raghav Chakravarthy left his law internship under then Delhi High Court Justice S Muralidhar (now a practising Senior Advocate) to attend a quiz tournament in Sweden, he did not know that it would inspire him to author Ready for the Law Challen
